# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 19 Improved Quarry widening
# fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level-1..level-18
# hybrid chassis (tests/sd18_ranger_level18_widening.rs, the loop's most
# recent Ranger ceiling) to Ranger level 19 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# is the level-18 fixture with the class level bumped -- no new choice
# slot is introduced, since the 19th-level "Special" column entry
# ("Improved quarry", verified independently against d20pfsrd and the
# Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both byte-for-byte identical) is
# an UPGRADE of the already-chosen 11th-level Quarry target
# (choice:ranger_quarry_target, already present below), not a new
# selection: the ranger's existing quarry-designation ability improves
# (free-action reselection instead of a standard action, take 20 instead
# of take 10 while tracking, the insight attack-roll bonus rising from +2
# to +4, and the post-kill/dismissal reselection cooldown shrinking from
# 24 hours/1 hour to a flat 10 minutes) -- it does not grant a new
# favored-enemy, favored-terrain, or combat-style-bonus-feat slot (19th
# level is not one of the Favored Enemy 5/10/15/20 intervals, the Favored
# Terrain 3/8/13/18 intervals, or the Combat Style Feat 2/6/10/14/18
# levels).
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-18 fixture unchanged. No
# action-economy engine and no Survival-check-execution engine exists in
# this codebase, so neither the free-action reselection nor the take-20
# tracking behavior is ever applied to any actual roll or action
# resolution; the fixture makes no such claim.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level19-sd18-improved-quarry
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:19

ability=intelligence:10

ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1

equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
